bibliography.title: Veritas: Generalizable Deepfake Detection via Pattern-Aware Reasoning

abstract_sentences.text: Deepfake detection remains a formidable challenge due to the evolving nature of fake content in real-world scenarios.

evidence.anchor: evolving nature of fake content

abstract_sentences.text: However, existing benchmarks suffer from severe discrepancies from industrial practice, typically featuring homogeneous training sources and low-quality testing images, which hinder the practical usage of current detectors.

evidence.anchor: homogeneous training sources and low-quality testing images

abstract_sentences.text: To mitigate this gap, we introduce HydraFake, a dataset that contains diversified deepfake techniques and in-the-wild forgeries, along with rigorous training and evaluation protocol, covering unseen model architectures, emerging forgery techniques and novel data domains.

evidence.anchor: diversified deepfake techniques and in-the-wild forgeries

abstract_sentences.text: Building on this resource, we propose Veritas, a multi-modal large language model (MLLM) based deepfake detector.

evidence.anchor: we propose Veritas

abstract_sentences.text: Different from vanilla chain-of-thought (CoT), we introduce pattern-aware reasoning that involves critical patterns such as “planning” and “self-reflection” to emulate human forensic process.

evidence.anchor: planning and self-reflection

abstract_sentences.text: We further propose a two-stage training pipeline to seamlessly internalize such deepfake reasoning capacities into current MLLMs.

evidence.anchor: two-stage training pipeline

abstract_sentences.text: Experiments on HydraFake dataset reveal that although previous detectors show great generalization on cross-model scenarios, they fall short on unseen forgeries and data domains.

evidence.anchor: fall short on unseen forgeries and data domains

abstract_sentences.text: Our Veritas achieves significant gains across different out-of-domain (OOD) scenarios, and is capable of delivering transparent and faithful detection outputs.

evidence.anchor: transparent and faithful detection outputs

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把传统 deepfake detector 的未见 forgery/domain 缺口写成 HydraFake 分层评测，再以 SFT → MiPO → P-GRPO 将 MLLM 转为可按难度展开的 pattern-aware forensic reasoning；性能、解释和消融都服务于同一 OOD 主线。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留四级 split、FS/FR/EFG-only training 控制、Eq. (1)–(6)、Table 1 主比较、Table 2/5 pattern 消融、Figure 4/5 stage/cold-start、Table 7/8 quality/robustness 与结论。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 完整 subset 规模与 P/R、硬件/epoch、prompt、reward rubric、cross-benchmark、效率、hyperparameter、失败案例、LLM-use、ethics 和集中 limitations 迁入附录；主线可读，但 faithfulness、低分辨率机制和 MiPO 数据构成需要回读附录。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 2 把数据来源、hierarchical protocol 与基线短板合图；Table 2/5 将 OOD effect 与 pattern deletion 对齐；Table 6 将 non-preference 角色对齐到性能；Table 13 与 Figure 22 同时暴露平均值下的低分辨率边界。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 主文先给 split-level average 和强的 “significant/faithful” 语气，统计不确定性与 subset heterogeneity 后置；IC-Light、DeepFaceLab/FFIW、视频范围和 causal faithfulness 没有闭合。A.6–A.9 的浮动图页还把调用文字与证据分开。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 跨分布能力主张应先把训练可见因素与测试未见因素写成互斥层级，再让主表、组件消融和失败案例分别回答“是否有效、为何有效、何时失效”。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适合有明确训练/测试分布与可核验输出的 detector 或 reasoning 系统；理论型论文不能用 benchmark 分层替代证明。此文仍未覆盖视频、长期部署、seed 不确定性或 causal faithfulness。
